external_sources.title: Evertse, On sums of S-units and linear recurrences (1984)
external_sources.interface: Corollary 1, printed p.227, equations (9)-(12); fixed dimension, fixed prime set, collective gcd and nondegeneracy.

external_sources.title: Evertse-Ferretti, A further improvement of the Quantitative Subspace Theorem (2013)
external_sources.interface: Fixed-height-system, dimension-dependent exceptional-subspace bounds; not an unbounded-atom corollary.

external_sources.title: Wu-Wang, On the irrationality measure of log 3 (2014)
external_sources.interface: Theorem 1 with constant coefficient zero; conversion to a rational approximation adds one to the exponent.

external_sources.title: Dubickas, On integer sequences generated by linear maps (2009)
external_sources.interface: Theorem 5: eventual parity-factor complexity lower bound on a divergent ordinary positive orbit.

external_sources.title: Knight, Collatz high cycles do not exist (2026)
external_sources.interface: Published high-cycle exclusion; not all bounded mixed-band physical words.

external_sources.title: Lean FRO and Mathlib Initiative, RH verification statement (2026-11-21)
external_sources.interface: Public independent certification of RH statement and proof; not independently rebuilt here and not an input to Collatz.

external_sources.title: An Arakelov-theoretic perspective on the Alpoge-Claude argument on RH (2026-11-22)
external_sources.interface: Section 1.2 slope-method input list; endpoint served PDF imprinted v3, no v1 byte-identity asserted; no geometric theorem transferred to Collatz.

external_sources.title: Calegari-Dimitrov-Tang, The unbounded denominators conjecture (2025)
external_sources.interface: Arithmetic holonomicity and modular uniformization context; no claimed applicability to arbitrary Collatz carry series.
